name: Revenue by Airline
query:
def execute(filters=None):
    airlines = frappe.get_all("Airline", fields=["name"])
    data = []

    for airline in airlines:
        # Modified query to check all tickets, not just submitted
        total_revenue = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT SUM(flight_price)
            FROM `tabAirplane Ticket`
            WHERE airline = %s
        """, (airline.name,), as_list=True)

        # If no data, set revenue to 0
        revenue = total_revenue[0][0] if total_revenue else 0

        data.append({
            "Airline": airline.name,
            "Revenue": revenue
        })
    
    # Handle case where no data is found
    if not data:
        frappe.msgprint("No data available for Revenue by Airline report.")
    
    return data
